Special Branch
No. 2.
(C. & S.B.) Office Notes

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE
C. I. D. REGISTRY
File No. I. O. D. / 358
Date 17 - 6 - 30.
June 16, 1930.

Sir,

Reference to the attached letter of June 11, 1930
which refers to the arrival of Admiral R. Wakatsuki,
Japanese Chief Delegate at the London Naval Conference.

Admiral R. Wakatsuki arrived per S.S. "Kitano
Maru," which berthed at the N.Y.K. Wayside Wharf at 5.30 a.m.
12-6-30. He remained on board until 9.20 a.m., when he
proceeded to No. 15 Seymour Road, the residence of the
Japanese Consul General, and remained in that residence
during his stay in Shanghai.

The following places were visited on the 12th.
Inspection tour of the Eastern and Western Districts.
At 7 p.m. attended a dinner at the Japanese Club. At
7.5 a.m. 13th departed from the North Station for Hangchow,
returning at night by the 10.45 p.m. and returned to No.
15 Seymour Road, where remained until the following
morning the 14th, when he departed from Shanghai at 11.15 a.m.
aboard the same steamer for Japan.

Protection was given by the Special Branch No. 2,
B. and D. Divisions, and nothing unforeseen occured.

M.R. Varnau
D. S.

III Seen
W.J.
D. C. (Divisions)

上海公共租界工部局警务处
刑事侦缉处档案室
档案号 I. O. D. / 358
日期 1930年6月17日。
1930年6月16日。

先生：

兹提及附上的1930年6月11日来信，
该信涉及出席伦敦海军会议的日本首席代表
若槻礼次郎（R. Wakatsuki）海军上将的抵达事宜。

若槻礼次郎海军上将乘坐“北野丸”号（S.S. "Kitano Maru"）轮船抵达，
该轮于1930年6月12日上午5时30分停靠在日清汽船公司（N.Y.K.）码头趸船。
他在船上停留至上午9时20分，随后前往西摩路15号，即日本总领事官邸，
并在其逗留上海期间一直居住在该官邸。

12日当天访问了以下地点。
巡视了东区及西区。
晚上7时出席了在日本俱乐部举行的晚宴。
13日上午7时5分从北站出发前往杭州，
当晚乘坐10时45分的列车返回，并回到西摩路15号，
在此停留至次日（14日）上午，
随后于上午11时15分乘坐同一艘轮船离开上海前往日本。

安保工作由特务科第2组、B分区及D分区提供，
未发生任何意外事件。

M.R. Varnau
副督察长（D.S.）

III 已阅
W.J.

Confidential
Commissioner of Police

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE
C. I. D. REGISTER
No. I. O. D. 1358
Date 17. 6. 30

The Japanese Authorities through A.C.
Japanese has requested that
protection be given to Admiral R. Wakatsuki
Chief Delegate at the London Naval
Conference who is due to arrive at
N. Y. K. Wayside Wharf on S.S. Kutano
Maru at 6 AM Wednesday June 12
th. and will stay at Majestic Hotel
to June 13 or 14. There appears to
be strong hostility from certain sections of
the Japanese Nation to the work of
the Japanese Delegation.
I have instructed D.O. "D" Division
to provide adequate guard in vicinity
of Pontoon Wharf and Yangtzepoo
Rd. a.c. Japanese does not
anticipate any trouble once the
motor car is well under way.
I have instructed DO "B" Division
to detail two Japanese in plain
clothes to guard the suite occupied
by Mr. Wakatsuki during his stay
at the Majestic plus one Chinese
detective to be on duty at the hotel

警务处处长

上海公共租界工部局警务处
刑事侦缉处登记簿
编号 I. O. D. 1358
日期 1930年6月17日

日本当局通过日本领事馆助理专员（A.C. Japanese）请求对
出席伦敦海军会议的日本首席代表
若槻礼次郎（R. Wakatsuki）海军上将提供保护，
他预计将于6月12日（星期三）上午6时
乘坐“北野丸”号（S.S. Kutano Maru，原文拼写有误，应为Kitano Maru）轮船抵达
日清汽船公司（N.Y.K.）码头趸船，
并将入住华懋公寓（Majestic Hotel），
直至6月13日或14日。日本国内某些阶层
似乎对日本代表团的工作存在强烈的敌意。
我已指示D分区督察长（D.O.）在
浮码头及杨树浦路附近提供充足的警卫。
日本领事馆助理专员预计，一旦汽车顺利启动行驶，
就不会出现任何麻烦。
我已指示B分区督察长（DO）派遣两名便衣日本巡捕
在华懋公寓守卫若槻先生所住的套房，
另加一名华籍侦探在酒店执勤
